title: Potatoism Canonical Corpus — Searchable Mythology
epistemic_rule: Everything in this file is part of the project's mythology, symbolism, interpretation or creative worldbuilding unless explicitly marked otherwise. It must not be presented as empirical proof about the physical world.
purpose: A dense searchable corpus for the Potato of Life, Tim Dooley, the Father, the Son, the Twin, the Lion, the Door, the North Axis, the Tree, Red/Blue Potato, Spudlight and related concepts.

records.name: Potato of Life
records.definition: The central symbol of the mythology: hidden life in matter, nourishment, persistence, reproduction, roots, memory and the possibility of growth from humble conditions.

records.name: Tim Dooley / Father
records.definition: The Father-side archetype of the Potatoverse: the organizing source above the Axis, associated with the Potato of Life, North, the Tree of Life and the conditions under which the lower world can develop.

records.name: The Son
records.definition: The embodied counterpart of the Father-side. The Son enters the Plane, encounters separation and strife, becomes Door and Vessel, passes through death/transformation and returns as a connective function.

records.name: Thomas / Twin
records.definition: The mirror motif connecting recognition, doubt, testing, witness and identity. The mythology uses Thomas/Twin as an architectural counterpart to the Son while preserving the distinction between ancient textual traditions and project interpretation.

records.name: Lion of Judah
records.definition: The Son's lion aspect: courage, kingship, sovereignty of spirit, protection and the transformation of vulnerability into purposeful action. In the project it is symbolic, not a claim of literal supernatural status.

records.name: The Door
records.definition: The threshold between domains. The Son becomes the Door because the Son is simultaneously an embodied participant and a passage between Father-side architecture and the Plane.

records.name: The Vessel
records.definition: The carrier that allows meaning, relationship or source to cross a boundary without erasing the distinction between domains.

records.name: North Axis
records.definition: The directional and relational spine of the mythology. North represents orientation, extremity, ascent, polar meeting and the point at which geography becomes symbolic architecture.

records.name: Throne of North
records.definition: The symbolic seat at the upper end of the North Axis: stillness, observation, orientation and responsibility rather than ordinary political office.

records.name: Tree of Life
records.definition: The vertical living architecture connecting roots, trunk, branches, fruit and seed. It models continuity between hidden foundations and visible outcomes.

records.name: Tree of Strife
records.definition: The failure-mode counterpart to the Tree of Life: fragmented relationships, fear, extraction, control, memory without renewal and expansion without roots.

records.name: Red Potato
records.definition: The outward and upward movement: creativity, love, emergence, exploration, connection, growth and expansion.

records.name: Blue Potato
records.definition: The inward and rootward movement: memory, precision, fear-awareness, conservation, inspection, continuity and preservation.

records.name: Spudlight
records.definition: The deliberately comic name for illumination arising from grounded life: meaning discovered in ordinary matter rather than imposed from above.

records.name: Father's House
records.definition: The upper dwelling/source metaphor in the project's cosmology. The thalamus is used as a metaphorical correspondence for a central relay or house, not as a scientific proof of the cosmology.

records.name: The Plane
records.definition: The experienced world of embodied beings, institutions, animals, material systems and ordinary causality in the mythology.

records.name: Dweller
records.definition: A being inside the Plane that sees only a limited slice of the larger architecture. The term emphasizes perspective, finitude and the danger of confusing one local measurement with total reality.

records.name: Dog
records.definition: A comic Potatoverse archetype for ordinary observers who bark, inspect, chase, misunderstand, learn and participate in the world while trying to understand the larger Potato.

records.name: Mud
records.definition: The low, material, messy starting condition from which growth emerges. Mud is not pure evil; it is the environment in which roots begin.

records.name: Swamp
records.definition: A metaphor for accumulated institutional, financial, ideological and relational muddiness. It is a systems metaphor and should not be treated as a literal hidden organization.

records.name: Drain
records.definition: A route through which energy, attention, trust or life is continually removed without regenerative return.

records.name: The Ladder
records.definition: A traversable connection between levels. In the mythology the transformed Door becomes a Ladder: boundary becomes route.

records.name: 33 Levels
records.definition: A project framework for describing ordered levels of experience, relation and transformation. It is an internal symbolic model, not a scientific measurement of dimensions.

records.name: Cube
records.definition: The enclosing spatial frame in the project's dimensional metaphor: the ordinary three-dimensional container in which the Plane is experienced.

records.name: Moon Cube
records.definition: A project-specific symbolic extension of the Cube, associated with reflection, cyclic observation and the moon as a mirror-like object.

records.name: 11-Dimensional Potato
records.definition: A deliberately audacious metaphor joining the Potatoverse to ideas from higher-dimensional theoretical physics. It is not a claim that Tim Dooley or a potato has been scientifically measured as an 11-dimensional manifold.

records.name: Meme-crucifixion
records.definition: The project's symbolic language for the Son's public death/transformation through the world of memes, observation, ridicule, conflict and digital identity.

records.name: North Pole
records.definition: The extreme northern point used as symbolic geography for the meeting of Christmas, Axis, polar orientation and transformation. It is not the historical location of the biblical crucifixion.

records.name: Potato Bank
records.definition: A project metaphor for stored value, accumulated resources, obligations and the ability of a system to transform saved potential into future growth.

records.name: 100,000 Hours
records.definition: A recurring project number representing extreme accumulated duration, persistence and the transformation of time into a structural feature of the mythology.

records.name: The Spiral
records.definition: A trajectory that revisits earlier states while changing scale, direction or understanding. The spiral prevents the mythology from treating progress as a straight line.

records.name: Love
records.definition: The constructive force that makes connection worth maintaining. In the Red/Blue dialectic it motivates growth while requiring memory and responsibility.

records.name: Fear
records.definition: A warning signal that can preserve life when integrated, but can become destructive when it controls the entire system.

records.name: North Programme
records.definition: The real-world research and policy layer extending the North Axis metaphor into an observable European economic graph. It maps institutions, money, infrastructure, energy, ownership, trade, labour, technology and strategic dependencies.
